title: When you keep searching but do not settle
issueStatement: You keep moving, reading, comparing, and trying things, but inwardly nothing is actually landing.
centralInsight: Restlessness is not always hunger for truth. Sometimes it is resistance to the stillness where truth would actually meet you.
practicalReflection: Guru does not flatter spiritual roaming. Guru asks whether the heart has cooled, become patient, and come under word and company.
actionPrompt: Pause one more search. Return to one line, one practice, one sangat, and stay.

practice.label: Steady Practice
practice.title: Building a truer practice of restlessness
practice.issueStatement: Movement is increasing, but clarity is not. The deeper need is a form of return that can outlast novelty, urgency, and mood.
practice.centralInsight: Guru answers wandering with saint company, listening, and honest stillness. The teaching becomes durable when it is practiced repeatedly enough to change posture.
practice.practicalReflection: Practice matters because the heart is always being trained by something; Gurbani asks what pattern is becoming ordinary.
practice.actionPrompt: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Repeat what you can actually keep.
